blocks.text: Francisi (French) naturalist Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744 - 1829) un shuru ke logon mein se the jinhon ne evolution ke khayal ki himayat ki. 1809 mein unhon ne ek kitab ‘Philosophie Zoologique’ (Zoological Philosophy) shaya ki. Is kitab mein unhon ne tabdeeli (progression) ka woh khayal pesh kiya jo Lamarckism kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Lamarck ki kitab ka naam ‘Philosophie Zooloqique’ chhapa hai; sahi naam ‘Philosophie Zoologique’ hai.

Lamarckism ke mutabiq jandar saada tareen (simplest) shakal se pecheeda (complex) shakal tak badle. Lamarck ka daawa tha ke jab jandar apne mahol ke mutabiq dhalte (adapt hote) hain to un mein tabdeeliyan aati hain. Lamarck ka bataya hua evolution ka tareeqa (mechanism) neeche samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Lamarck kaun the aur unhon ne apna khayal kis kitab mein pesh kiya?
blocks.explanation: Lamarck (1744 - 1829) ek French naturalist the jo evolution ke khayal ke shuru ke himayati the. Unhon ne 1809 mein ‘Philosophie Zoologique’ mein apna khayal (Lamarckism) pesh kiya.

items: Lamarck (1744 - 1829), French naturalist; 1809 mein ‘Philosophie Zoologique’ mein Lamarckism pesh kiya.
